# `accounts.current_account.AccountDebited`

A settlement CAPTURE landed a real DEBIT on the demand account ([ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md): ConfirmDebit -> HoldCaptured + Debit Movement) — a reservation turned into money actually leaving (funding a deposit at constitution, collecting a loan installment). The matching operations.HoldCaptured (the spine-owned earmark release, [ADR-PC-033](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-033-account-abstraction-and-hold-lifecycle.md)) is appended in the SAME batch, so the hold leaves the active set and this Debit posts atomically. The Debit Movement is Observed in the [ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md) 'engine-internal already-effected' sense, so no Originated header is emitted and no SECOND saga starts on the account's own event (the loop-breaker). Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2) — opaque refs, integer cents, an input date.

## Payload fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | `string` (`uuid`) | AccountId (Guid) — the account stream the capture debit is appended to. Never PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `account_ref` | `string` | The account's opaque spine key the Debit Movement posts against (AccountPosition.AccountRef) — a reference the engine resolves internally, NEVER an IBAN/PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `amount_cents` | `long` | The captured (settled) amount as a positive integer EUR cents (Money.Cents, [ADR-PC-010](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-010-dotnet-hand-rolled-engine.md) §P1) — the source Movement.Amount the writer lands (the in-band WRONG-AMOUNT guard, [ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md)). Posted as a Debit so the accounting balance moves down. |
| `hold_id` | `string` | The reservation this capture settles (the [ADR-PC-033](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-033-account-abstraction-and-hold-lifecycle.md) hold lifecycle key) — the SAME HoldId the matching operations.HoldCaptured carries, so the capture and its Debit name one earmark. A structural token, never PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `intent_reference` | `string` | The [ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md) slot-4 economic-intent reference the append command_id is derived from — carried for audit/lineage, NEVER the HTTP Idempotency-Key. A structural token, never PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `value_date` | `int` (`date`) | ValueDate (DateOnly) as days since epoch — the capture's economic value-date, a caller-supplied input, never a clock read in a fold ([ADR-PC-023](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-023-temporal-signals-projection-derived.md)). |
| `movements` | `array<`record`>` | The capture as ONE Observed Debit Movement against account_ref ([ADR-PC-032](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-032-money-movement-primitive.md) slot 5). A REQUIRED array (an empty array, never null) defaulted to [] so pre-Movement records still decode (forward-only, [ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P3 / BACKWARD compat). No Originated header is emitted (the loop-breaker), so this event starts no settlement saga. |
